app.title: BooruFlow
home.subtitle: Search, review, organize and maintain Booru metadata from one workspace.
home.review: Find and review tags by category or text list.
home.tagging: Inspect under-tagged posts without automatic submission.
home.organization: Maintain the local tag taxonomy and its sources.
home.cleanup: Audit existing folders before recoverable cleanup.
home.options: Configure sites, databases, language and credentials.
home.grabber: Generate and resume Grabber batches when the optional tool is available.
page.review: Category review and TXT-list review will be consolidated here.
page.tagging: Manual browser-assisted tagging review will be migrated here.
page.organization: Taxonomy browsing, editing and source updates will live here.
page.cleanup: Folder drop, audit progress and recoverable actions will live here.
page.grabber: This section is optional. The rest of BooruFlow remains usable without Grabber.
options.note: Credentials are stored only in the local config folder and are excluded from Git.
options.database_running: Updating {site} database… Details are shown in the journal.
options.database_already_running: A database update is already running.
options.database_failed: {site} database update stopped with code {code}. See the journal.
review.queries: One search per line (semicolon also accepted):
review.auto_continue: Continue automatically when nothing is retained
review.example: Example: with {total} total results, {percent}% requires at least {required} matching result(s).
review.interrupted: Review stopped or failed. See the log.
review.count_gelbooru_only: Pre-scan counting is currently available for Gelbooru.
review.credentials_missing: Gelbooru credentials are missing. Add them in Options.
review.continuing: Nothing retained; continuing automatically at page {page}…
tagging.ready: Ready. Results open in your authenticated browser; BooruFlow never submits tags.
tagging.end: Actual end reached after {examined} post(s); nothing retained.
tagging.finished: Completed — {examined} post(s) examined, {retained} retained. Double-click a result to open it.
cleanup.group: Audit downloaded images against the Grabber blacklist
cleanup.help: Drop one or more folders here. The audit is read-only; deletion is never automatic.
cleanup.no_folder: No folder selected. Add or drop at least one folder.
cleanup.report: CSV report: {path} — ignored rules: {compound} compound, {non_tag} non-tag.
cleanup.recycling: Sending {count} file(s) to the Windows Recycle Bin…
cleanup.recycle_done: Files sent to the Recycle Bin. The CSV report was kept.
cleanup.recycle_failed: Recycle Bin operation was incomplete. Run a new audit before continuing.
grabber.group: Create and process batches of tabs
grabber.no_session: No session loaded. Paste tags or load a list, then create a session.
grabber.created: Session created: {tags} tag(s), {batches} batch(es), {skipped} blacklisted/ignored tag(s) removed.
grabber.progress: Batch {current}/{total} ready — {tags} tag(s) in this session.
grabber.running: Grabber is open. Close it after reviewing the current batch.
grabber.failed: Grabber exited abnormally (code {code}); the current batch remains active.
grabber.next: Batch completed; launching the next one automatically.

organization.empty_entry: Legacy empty entry: no child category or cached definition is stored.
organization.no_tag_selected: Select a tag to inspect it
organization.details_loading: Loading wiki information and example images…
organization.wiki_empty: The wiki was reached, but its page contains no description.
